book.name: Gutut
book.title: Gutut Iesu watu enamot mega nagire guturewa

content: Sol waenapan tone boen ase yave anega wan, “Umap.” God menan pot pot anun taiwanumune apane wai upi irip turup bawarevet wan amba Sitiven etua tun. Sol Iesu dugup mega nagirewa wa koeragam mumen Wam ame Ierusalem gapan wa koeragam aritavet da Iesu dugup mega nagirewa inamup tane. Ap menan, Iesu dugup mega nagirewa iravi punanan waran at Diudia ge at Sameria amon go Iesu watu enamot mega aonagaet pusinawan dere mugenat Ierusalem gapan wanumon.
Apan Sol den Iesu dugup mega nagirewa gut okonak mumiwandini. Pa pa iragi tau ge tau ae waenapan upe okonage ae gwat nokap semuiwandin.
Pilip at Sameria gapan wadidiamuiwandin
Iesu anu tumasine nagirewa da da punanan wat amone nagirewa at at Iesu oisewa wadidiam wanumun.
Ap gapan den, Pilip at Sameria gapan pa bawarewa ame vit ae Keriso oise wadidiam wandin.
Pilip nop amunu den ge yo ugup ugup taiwandini menan waenapan keam ton yaviwanumun.
Yo ame taiwandin gapan airampu no yani den waenapan potap tap tau amuiwanumun, ge pusi gegerawa amba etumu gwade waniwa inak waran ap amon.
Ap menan at Sameria gapan inak ame yawane waenapan ni gwane ao tan aton tane.
Kayao banao apane Iesu anu tumasen

Wam ame gapan, at Sameria gapan, apan da yaua Saimon, banao pa sewa ame gwanap taiwandin. At Sameria nagirewa yawan seke tan no i kap waiwanumun. Saimon mek ingane yaua wabawarame aritawa apane da wa taiwandin.
Waenapan iragi aigapewa ge gauarapewa nagirewa nop mega neman guran anune anega wane, “Apan Saimon mam, nu God nugawa, yaua Aro Aigap Iragenawa, kimani aoma viseni apanewa mame di.”
Me wam wam nuat mega taiwandini menan waenapan nomu i kap wan tarage waiwanumune amba me ewap di amuiwanumun.
Pilip taue God toemu mega oisewa kakaewa amba Iesu guturewa den wadidiamon. Nop ame waenapan anu tumasene gapan mu dup iamon.
Saimon mek ingane den Iesu anu tumat ta dup ien. Pilip ap aiwandini Saimon den tane aiwandin iwa Pilip yo kimani paua baware ugup ugup taiwandini Saimon yave no kap wan.

Wam ame at Sameria nagirewa God noa anu warane oisewa Iesu watu enamot mega nagirewa pa Ierusalem gapan anun. Ap menan mu Iesu watu enamot megawa dere Pita ge Dion watu enamone Sameria nagirewa inamup amon.
Wam ame mu tauanewa, Sameria anu tumat nagirewa munan mup wane ame Guewa Woup Seniwa inamup tauep warapen menan.
Iwa mu Iesu anu tumat tane amba Iesu yaua gapan dup iamon go Guewa Woup Seniwa aigamup ya visen.
Boge Pita ge Dion nanimu iamup seane amba mu Guewa Posewa Woup Seni warane.
Iesu watu enamot megawa dere ap anega tane gapan God Guewa yan muneni ame apan Saimon ase yaven. Menan Saimon aro ame warapen menan garewa munat anu,
anega wadiamon, “Aro mame ne den nenane amba da da nanina iamup seapena mu Guewa Woup Seniwa den warain.”
Go Pita gare anega wan, “Ge evi amba moni gegawa den merao arewa age bogitai! Iwa ge God aro ma nuniniwa moni gapan une tat anuan!
Ge nu den nao daitonawa da uon iwa ge inak gega God yamap ebo aopan no dotouen.
Ma koewa gega entan tapen anua, God inap vetavet ta, mup wa. Ayop, ge imuga koewa anuana, anu ae veta go uon, ne oare,
iwa gek anu koeam tan sisiwa potagap no dotouen menan koewa panagen yavivin.”
Amba Saimon tap anu Pita ge Dion anega diamon, “Ayop inap nenan mup wa oitana koewa gat waana inanap ya tauep.”

Wam ame Pita ge Dion Ayop Iesu inak mega gapan dim dim ase yawane ame guturewa wadidiamone amba mu entanen pa Ierusalem sia amon. Mu sewa Sameria pa muga arugataet tau ge tau amon God No Oise Kakaewa opata gapan wadiam amuiwanumun.
At Itiopia apan da Iesu anu tumasen
Go Pilip ap mepe wandeni gapan, God anea mega da apan Pilip inap taue anega dien, “Negin Ierusalem ae Gasa taueni, at kaimewa negin ap me ak.”

Boge me ao yone neginaet aiwandin eni at Itiopia gorowa apane da tautanen. Apan ame, at Itiopia ayop mugawa waenewa yaua Kandasi, ame moni mega kwayupe taini aritawa muga yonen. Me God inap mup wapen men Ierusalem aen.
Aeni ame ewagai sia entan neginaet pimai mega man osi warupiwanumune ame gagap wande aiwandin. Buka da watageta apane Aisaya God nop mega ok seni ame batnak aiwandin.
Amba God Guewa Pilip anega dien, “Age pimai gagap amoine ase mainep mainep agingan.”

Boge Pilip serarat ae osi pimai warupiwanumune ame ine taueni apan gorowa ame watageta apane Aisaya buka mega batnak wandin anun. Menan Pilip anega wayaven, “Ge ok ame batnagingiana iwa anuingi go uon?”
Itiopia apanewa gare anega wan, “Ne anenen anu awain, go orup da guegue mega wadianegepiwa, ne iwa mega anu awain.” Ap wani boge, Pilip dore pimai mega gagap dere wanumopen menan wan.
Boge apan gorowa ame God no oise seane koni da anega batnagiwandin,

content.text: Me man sip togurapen amoine mini,
ge man sip otua gume ketnagiwanumune gapan,
no uon wandini mini, me nop da daiton ya wan.
Me inap ta koeamene umame anun,
amba mu wanene eboewa gapan tane go me no uon wanden,
Me inak mega piup ma gapana uon tani menan,
naewa mega da uon. Ap menan me oisewa waenapan da wadidiamuiwandata.

content: Amba gorowa apane ame Pilip singui tayaven, “Endi wadianek apan Aisaya ma da nop mega waiwan, mek menan waiwan go orup da menan waiwan?”
Amba Pilip boge Aisaya nop mega ame uap sia wadien ge nop oit kakaewa gapan Iesu oisewa den wadien.
Pilip ge gorowa apan ame neginaet amoin ene kaum da tauane, apan gorowa ame anega wan, “Kaum da ma yao, kaum ma gapan dup ianek ianek anenen?”
Pilip gare wadien, “Ge imuga potaga God anu tumasewa ne dup iagain.” Goroa apane gare wan, “Iesu Keriso God Otua di, ne anu tumasivin.”
Boge man osi pimai mega warupen gagap amuiwanumune wan ae yonan. Ame Pilip ge gorowa apane ap mepe ae vitan kaum amon, boge Pilip gorowa apane ame ware dup ien.
Wam ame mu kaum ae vean amba kwatata ae ma dotouane, ame gine tutup God Guewa aroewa gapan Pilip wat oagasen, menan gorowa apane Pilip da sia ya yaven go me neginaet atonu den aen.
Pilip ap mepe oagaeni boge at ugupewa yaua Asidot ap mepe ase matagaen amba ap ta God No Oise Kakaewa opata gapan pa sewa sewa iragi wadiam wadiam aeni amba at Sisaria tauen.
